purpose: Form NCLT-16 is used for recording the deposition of a witness.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Record the deposition of a witness in Form NCLT-16.
Have the Members constituting the Bench initial each page of the deposition.
Carry out and initial any corrections pointed out by the witness if the Bench is satisfied.
Append a note at the bottom of the deposition if the Bench is not satisfied with corrections.
checklist: Ensure Form NCLT-16 is used for the witness deposition.
Ensure each page has space for Members of the Bench to initial.
Note any corrections requested by the witness for Bench review.
watch: Make sure the Bench initials every single page of the deposition.
